en-US.description: Regulatory viewer for reviewing eCTD submissions.
en-US.longDescription: ROSETTA eCTD Viewer (Desktop Edition) is a regulatory software tool for reviewing eCTD submissions, supporting multiple regional specifications including EU, US, Japan, China, and Canada. Reviewers can navigate the submission structure, validate sequences, and inspect documents offline. The desktop edition runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11.
en-US.name: ROSETTA eCTD Viewer Desktop Edition

zh-CN.description: 用于审阅 eCTD 申报资料的法规事务查看器。
zh-CN.longDescription: ROSETTA eCTD Viewer（桌面版）是一款用于审阅 eCTD 申报资料的法规事务软件，支持欧盟、美国、日本、中国、加拿大等多种地区规范。审阅者可以浏览申报结构、校验序列并离线查看文档。桌面版支持 Windows 10 与 Windows 11。
